identity.title: Hosted Gitleaks Enforcement
identity.objective: Close S10-CI-SEC-02-D001: make real secret detection mandatory and fail-closed inside the already-required ci-final-gate job by installing the pinned official gitleaks 8.27.2 Linux x64 release with strict SHA-256 verification before extraction, running a redacted full-history git scan with the committed default-rule configuration and exact fingerprints, and executing the five existing binary-backed detection test cases with zero skips, all before the existing final plan verification; no new job, workflow, routing, ruleset or scanner-configuration change.
